definition.gate: R63 frozen-criterion dev probe: does the whole three-byte character at the object edge control content failure

held_constant.stems: the same 14 stems R61/R62 dealt (12 new + 2 replication), same sha256 deal, no re-deal
held_constant.template: 2-hop 把{object}放到{place}; records written as {desc}是{name}。 and {desc}对应{name}。

intervention.scope: character arms force the three bytes of the edge character; lead arms force only its first byte; every other position decodes freely
intervention.mechanism: override the post-mask emitted byte before advance_custom at each forced position, so the state carries the forced bytes

arms.none: no override; also the anchor arm
arms.sham: override with the bytes the none arm already emitted at those positions
arms.put_char: override with the three bytes of 放 (E6 94 BE)
arms.yu_char: override with the three bytes of 玉 (E7 8E 89)
arms.put_lead: override with E6 only, the R62 one-byte arm, kept to read source splitting
arms.yu_lead: override with E7 only, the R62 one-byte arm, kept to read source splitting

intervention.decodes: 48 new cells x 6 arms + 8 replication cells x none = 296
intervention.not_applicable: a cell whose decode never reaches a forced position has that position disclosed, not silently dropped

anchor.on_mismatch: engineering_failure; no character-level result is interpreted

machinery_guards.sham_identity: sham raw bytes and both kept edge traces must equal the none arm bitwise on every applicable new cell
machinery_guards.force_applied: every forced position that the decode actually visits must carry the forced value
machinery_guards.no_op_consistency: where the forced payload equals the natural payload, that arm must equal the sham arm bitwise

per_cell_report.char_reached: the three bytes at the object edge equal the forced target character
per_cell_report.sentence_exact: the whole answer is byte exact against the declared target
per_cell_report.same_source: the lead byte and the two trailing bytes belong to the same character, i.e. the edge bytes equal the target character; reported for lead arms, where the model picks the trailing bytes itself
per_cell_report.char_truncated: the decode emitted fewer than three bytes at the edge, so the character is incomplete and is disclosed
per_cell_report.classification: each new cell is classified by whether the whole character changed and whether the sentence stayed exact, not by rescue counts alone

denominators.rescue_candidates: new cells whose none arm is not byte exact and whose natural edge character is not 放
denominators.break_candidates: new cells whose none arm is byte exact and whose natural edge character is not 玉
denominators.rescued: rescue candidates whose put_char arm is byte exact
denominators.broken: break candidates whose yu_char arm is not byte exact
denominators.rates: rescued / rescue candidates, broken / break candidates
denominators.char_granularity_undetermined: cells where the forced character was reached but the sentence is not byte exact; listed as character-granularity evidence, never as a wrong forcing method

branches_in_order: sham identity, force applied or no-op consistency violated -> engineering_failure
cpu or wall over cap -> budget_stop
either candidate count is zero -> intervention_unmeasurable
both rates == 1 and every char arm reached its target on its candidates -> char_handle_complete
both rates == 1 but some candidate's target character was not reached -> char_handle_partial
classifier.note: branches are mutually exclusive and evaluated in this order; every cell is reported with its character-level classification

main_task_rule.char_handle_complete: the whole character at the object edge is a causal handle for content in both directions; still not a capability claim and still no relaxation of the 192/192 shape limit
main_task_rule.char_handle_one_direction: the character is causal in the named direction only; the other direction stays a companion readout
main_task_rule.char_handle_partial: counts are reported per cell; no mechanism sentence beyond the counts
main_task_rule.char_handle_none: the character is not a handle; the R61 predictor stays a companion readout and R61 limit (c) stands

gates.structural_pass: 12 structural cells exact AND every none-arm cell field_lengths_ok
gates.anchor_match: all 56 none-arm cells equal R61 on every declared field and the compared field count is 1890
gates.sham_identity: all applicable sham cells bitwise equal none
gates.force_applied: all visited forced positions carry the forced value
gates.no_op_consistency: arms whose payload equals the natural payload equal sham bitwise

definition.scope: dev/synthetic only; the sealed confirm split and its holdout report are not read; no change to 192/192; conclusions limited to these stems, place 6 B and this description pair
definition.estimate_rule: D-64: single run x 3 (one run plus two replay margins) + report assembly

unit_price_source.caveat: D-69/D-71/D-74 logged unattributed unit-price drift across rounds; the cap, not the estimate, binds

definition.reimplementation_disclosure: the decode loop is r62.decode, which already reproduced all 56 R61 cells bit for bit; R63 only widens the forced payload from one byte to three and does not edit that loop

immutability: written once before the run; never rewritten
